name: Troy (United States)
description: Blue field charged with a white figure of Athena with spear and shield, under the arched words TROY, MICHIGAN and with the motto City of Tomorrow, Today and the date 1955 in white.
history: Troy is a city in Oakland County, Michigan, incorporated in 1955. Flags of the World records the flag as seen at the 2010 Michigan Municipal League convention and doubts that the simplified drawing on Wikipedia is official.

features.role: words TROY, MICHIGAN, the motto City of Tomorrow, Today and the date 1955
